```ts
export interface WorkOptions {
    readonly queues?: readonly string[];
    readonly sleep?: number;
    readonly maxJobs?: number;
    readonly maxTime?: number;
    readonly stopWhenEmpty?: boolean;
    readonly stopTimeout?: number;
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
    readonly watchOtherQueues?: number | false;
    readonly onStuck?: (job: ReservedJob, error: JobStuckError) => void;
}
// WorkResult
export interface WorkResult {
    readonly processed: number;
    readonly failed: number;
    readonly released: number;
    readonly reason: 'empty' | 'max-jobs' | 'max-time' | 'stopped' | 'interrupted';
}
```

## Environment

```ts
// DB_QUEUE
`DB_QUEUE` → `QUEUE_DATABASE_QUEUE` (renamed)
// DB_QUEUE_CONNECTION
`DB_QUEUE_CONNECTION` → `QUEUE_DATABASE_CONNECTION` (renamed)
// DB_QUEUE_RETRY_AFTER
`DB_QUEUE_RETRY_AFTER` → `QUEUE_DATABASE_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS` (renamed)
// QUEUE_CONNECTION
`QUEUE_CONNECTION` → `QUEUE_DRIVER` (renamed)
// QUEUE_DATABASE_CONNECTION
`QUEUE_DATABASE_CONNECTION` = `"default"`
// QUEUE_DATABASE_QUEUE
`QUEUE_DATABASE_QUEUE` = `"default"`
// QUEUE_DATABASE_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS
`QUEUE_DATABASE_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS` = `90`
// QUEUE_DRIVER
`QUEUE_DRIVER` = `"database"`
// QUEUE_FAILED_CONNECTION
`QUEUE_FAILED_CONNECTION` — optional
// QUEUE_FAILED_DRIVER
`QUEUE_FAILED_DRIVER` = `"database"`
// QUEUE_REDIS_CONNECTION
`QUEUE_REDIS_CONNECTION` = `"default"`
// QUEUE_REDIS_QUEUE
`QUEUE_REDIS_QUEUE` = `"default"`
// QUEUE_REDIS_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS
`QUEUE_REDIS_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS` = `90`
// REDIS_QUEUE
`REDIS_QUEUE` → `QUEUE_REDIS_QUEUE` (renamed)
// REDIS_QUEUE_CONNECTION
`REDIS_QUEUE_CONNECTION` → `QUEUE_REDIS_CONNECTION` (renamed)
// REDIS_QUEUE_RETRY_AFTER
`REDIS_QUEUE_RETRY_AFTER` → `QUEUE_REDIS_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS` (renamed)
```

## Commands

```ts
// make:queue-table
marmeon make:queue-table [--module=system]
--module (string, short m)
// queue:failed
marmeon queue:failed
// queue:flush
marmeon queue:flush
// queue:forget
marmeon queue:forget <id>
// queue:prune-failed
marmeon queue:prune-failed [--hours=168]
--hours (string)
// queue:retry
marmeon queue:retry <id…|all>
// queue:size
marmeon queue:size [queue…] [--connection=database|redis]
--connection (string)
// queue:work
marmeon queue:work [--connection=database|redis] [--queue=mail,default] [--max-jobs=N] [--max-time=S] [--sleep=1] [--stop-timeout=10] [--stop-when-empty]
--connection (string)
--max-jobs (string)
--max-time (string)
--queue (string)
--sleep (string)
--stop-timeout (string)
--stop-when-empty (boolean)
```
